to.description: For set: the model chosen, or off. For unlock: on or off.

applied.description: True once the change was written (or undone).

accounts.description: Claude subscription accounts whose settings.json is this file.

state.description: fable, opus, sonnet: advisorModel names that model; other: another value (see model); off: not set or empty; missing: no settings.json; blocked: cannot be changed safely (see reason).

betasOff.description: The file's env sets CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS to a true value, which turns off Claude Code's experimental features, the advisor among them. Choosing a model removes it.

betasValue.description: That value as JSON, such as "1"; only with betasOff.

apiAccounts.description: Claude API accounts that use this same file. Where the variable is removed, config claude.apiBetasOff gives it to them at launch instead.

undo.description: sideby changed it here and can put the earlier value back.

undoApiBetas.description: With undo: that change turned config claude.apiBetasOff on for this file, and undo puts it back.

groups.description: For status, every file; for a preview, the files that would change.

skipped.description: For a preview: files of the scope sideby cannot change (no settings.json, or unsafe).

unlock.description: Config advisor.unlock: sessions sideby starts for Claude subscription accounts get CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_ADVISOR_TOOL=1.

unlocks.description: For a preview: the change also turns advisor.unlock on.

removesBetas.description: For a preview of a model: the listed groups with betasOff also lose env.CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS in the same write.

apiBetasOff.description: Config claude.apiBetasOff: Claude API accounts sideby starts get CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS=1 (a value in their proxy.env or the environment wins). After a change, its new value.

apiAccounts.description: For a preview of a model: API accounts whose settings file loses the variable; they keep it through claude.apiBetasOff.

apiBetasOn.description: For a preview of a model: the change also turns claude.apiBetasOff on.

apiBetasBack.description: For a preview of undo: claude.apiBetasOff also goes back to its earlier value.

envOff.description: A variable in the environment that makes Claude Code hide the advisor.

command.description: Run it after the user agrees: it shows the plan and exits 10; then --yes.

installed.description: The skill's version; null when it has none.

command.description: `sideby update`, which updates the skill with sideby: run it after the user agrees; it shows the plan and exits 10, then --yes.

_notice.description: Not the answer to the task: mention it briefly afterwards and offer to update.
